A therapist or helper might step back because you’re doing so much better, and suddenly your little one is wailing. For a while the old you is gone and the new you hasn’t shown up yet. Tibetan Buddhism calls an in-between state like that a bardo (I’m only borrowing the word, so what it teaches about death and rebirth is up to you).
